requirements.requirement: The system must include a composite_score field in the FastAPI response model for provider evaluation responses.
The system must include a component_measures field containing at least three individual measure scores in the API response.
The system must ensure the composite_score value in the API response matches exactly the value returned by the EvaluateCare facade.
The system must serialize the composite_score as a numeric type (float or int) in the API response.
The system must serialize component_measures as a structured JSON object or array with named measures and their values.
The system must update tool_router outputs to include composite_score and component_measures when present in the facade response.
The system must preserve backward compatibility by not removing or renaming any existing response fields in main.py.
The system must include composite_score and component_measures in all provider evaluation responses where scoring data is available.
The system must omit composite_score and component_measures fields or return them as null when scoring data is not available from the facade.
The system must return a valid FastAPI response conforming to the updated Pydantic response model without validation errors.
The system must ensure consistent field naming between FastAPI response models and tool_router outputs for composite_score and component_measures.
The system must handle the exception where the facade returns malformed scoring data by excluding the scoring fields and still returning a valid response.
The system must handle the exception where serialization of scoring fields fails by returning an HTTP 500 error with a structured error message.
